prediction_cadence: monthly research panel; daily operational panel later
negative_rules: No positive event observed is not a negative until the registered horizon matures.
Source absence is not a negative when source health or coverage is uncertain.
A completed move can be an event truth positive but a captureability negative at the prediction date.
leakage_controls: Every feature must have observed_at <= prediction_at.
Late corrections preserve first-observed and corrected values.
Post-contact and future permit-stage information are forbidden.
Historical snapshots are reconstructed from archived vintages, not current-state overwrite.
